title: TeamProfile
description: TeamClaw team profile package (vertical-team-profiles-design.md section 2.1). v1 subset: the fields TeamClaw consumes today (id/name/nameZh/industry/icon/version/description/roles/capabilities/warmupRoles/defaultRole). The remaining design fields (labelZh, params, domainInstructions, outputConstraints, glossary, workflows, knowledgePacks, deliverableHints, reviewedBy) are reserved as optional so industry packs can carry them before their consumers land (Phase 2+). NOTE: src/src/profile-loader.ts validates against this file with a self-contained interpreter of the keyword subset used below (type/enum/required/properties/additionalProperties/items/minItems/uniqueItems/minLength/pattern; additionalProperties only as literal false) - no external JSON Schema dependency is added to the runtime; extending the schema means extending that interpreter in the same change.

schemaVersion.description: Profile schema format version. Additive-only evolution (design section 2.2); a version this build does not support is a fatal load error, never a silent skip.

id.description: Profile slug, e.g. software-rd, crossborder-ecom, banking.

reviewedBy.description: Reserved (Phase 3): domain reviewer sign-off records; mandatory for the finance packs before release.

description.description: One-line summary of the team the profile describes.

params.description: Reserved (Phase 3): industry parameters, e.g. ecom primaryPlatform. Free-form until consumers land.

labelZh.description: Chinese display label (Phase 2.6). Optional: when absent, UI consumers fall back to label via the loader's resolveRoleDisplayName rule; present-but-empty fails load validation so the fallback never has to compete with a blank string.

recommendedSkills.description: ClawHub skills preinstalled for the role.

systemPrompt.description: Full role system prompt. software-rd keeps this byte-identical to the roles.ts registry (Phase 1.7 golden).

suggestedNextRoles.description: Role ids suggested for follow-up tasks.

roles.description: The role registry this team runs with.

domainInstructions.description: Industry guardrails (Phase 2.4, design 2.1/2.4). On profiles that set this field the lines REPLACE buildRoleOperatingRules wholesale in the controller and worker prompt pipelines - the software engineering operating rules are NOT injected. software-rd must not set this field (fatal cross-validation in profile-loader).

outputConstraints.description: Reserved (Phase 3): output-side hard constraints; mandatory for the finance packs.

glossary.description: Reserved (Phase 3): industry terminology injected into prompts.

workflows.description: Reserved (Phase 3): declarative workflow templates with conclusion branches (design section 2.4).

capabilities.description: Software capability switches. Phase 1 exposes the data; the short-circuit consumers land in Phase 2.3.

warmupRoles.description: Role ids pre-warmed at startup (cost control: 3-4 core roles max).

knowledgePacks.description: Reserved (Phase 4): static knowledge pack files shipped with the profile.

deliverableHints.description: Reserved (Phase 2+): deliverable preview semantics for the industry (replaces the runnable-preview prompt wording).

defaultRole.description: Role id used when no better signal exists (role-inference miss, unconfigured startup provisioning).
